title: Down Syndrome and Continuous Positive Pressure Therapy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and tolerability of Continuous Positive Pressure for SAOS in Down Syndrome patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Down Syndrome patients with an Obstructive Sleep Apnea Syndrome
* more than 18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* predictable non-compliance of device
* non-compensated cardiopathy
* non-stable thyroxin treatment
* non-stable diabetes
